session.summary: Analyzed the libGDX RTS codebase (wrote CLAUDE.md), then implemented elevation-based line-of-sight: units and the ALT sight overlay now occlude behind hills. Fixed two latent bugs along the way.

project_facts.gradle_root: main/ (NOT repo root) - run gradle from main/
project_facts.unused_deps: ashley (ECS) and gdx-box2d are on classpath but NOT used - units are plain OOP, no ECS, no physics, no pathfinding

environment_limitation.reason: Only JDK 21 installed (Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-21); project targets release 23. Also gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar is absent (only .properties present) and no system gradle.
environment_limitation.implication: Verify changes by inspection here; user compiles/runs in IntelliJ.

terrain_system.critical_note: The forest mask carries NO elevation data and vice-versa. Elevation queries MUST use the elevation/topography mask. Passing the forest mask to elevation code makes getElevationAt return NONE (inert).

1_CLAUDE_md.note: Full architecture doc. User asked for 'claude/CLAUDE.md'; put at repo root (auto-loaded). Documents stack, modules, subsystems, gaps (no base building / economy / enemy AI / win-lose / pathfinding), conventions.

2_elevation_sight.goal: Finish sight system: hills block line of sight. On plain you see a unit ON a hill, but not one BEHIND the hill.
2_elevation_sight.latent_bug_fixed: VisibilitySystem AND FogOfWarRenderer were both constructed with only the FOREST mask, so their elevation tiers/stealth were inert. Now both take (forestMask, elevationMask); GameScreen passes terrainMask + terrainCombatMask.
2_elevation_sight.occlusion_rule_FINAL: A tile blocks sight only if it is taller than BOTH the observer and the target by more than ELEVATION_BLOCK_MARGIN (= 1.0). Lower/equal terrain never blocks -> high ground sees across and down freely; only a ridge taller than both endpoints hides what is behind it.
rejected_approaches: Linear-interpolated sightline height + margin: blocked a unit standing in a large highland from seeing out (rim self-occlusion).
Running max-SLOPE viewshed for the ALT overlay: locked the horizon at observer height across a flat highland top, so on high ground the overlay showed 'nothing visible'. This was the reported bug.
2_elevation_sight.constant: ELEVATION_BLOCK_MARGIN = 1.0f, duplicated in BOTH VisibilitySystem and FogOfWarRenderer - keep equal so overlay matches detection. Lower it to make gentler slopes (PRE_HIGHLANDS) also occlude.
2_elevation_sight.ALT_overlay: FogOfWarRenderer.renderCursorSightOverlay casts 720 rays; each ray breaks on forest, map edge, or when a passed crest exceeds max(cursorHeight, pointHeight)+margin. Heavier now (samples getElevationAt per 6px step) but only runs while ALT held; drop RAY_COUNT or raise STEP if laggy.

verified_behavior: Observer on HIGHLANDS region: sees across + down onto lower ground (was: nothing)
Observer on plain, hill ahead: sees up-slope + crest, area BEHIND hill hidden
Enemy on hilltop: visible from lower ground
Gentle PRE_HIGHLANDS rise (1 tier): does not block (under margin)
Observer in lowland pit ringed by higher ground: blocked by rim (consistent both systems)
known_gaps_next: isPointVisible() (fog tile check) still range-only - ignores forest AND elevation. Fog reveals terrain behind hills even though units there are hidden. Candidate follow-up.
No enemy AI, no base building, no resources/economy, no win/lose, no pathfinding, no tests.
Debug Gdx.app.log calls in combat/unit hot path (Unit.update, CombatManager.tryAttack).
ELEVATION_BLOCK_MARGIN duplicated in two files - could centralize.
conventions: Dispose everything: each subsystem owns and disposes its SpriteBatch/ShapeRenderer/Texture/Pixmap.
Terrain masks sampled with Y flipped (world Y up, pixmap Y down) - see TerrainMaskManager.getPixelFromMask.
Artillery is excluded from the normal attack()/order pipeline - guard combat code with 'instanceof Artillery'.
visibleToPlayer gates BOTH rendering and targeting - respect it everywhere.
